verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party TPRM product says it discovers vendors, accelerates assessments, and monitors third-party risk. It also pulls findings from vendor SOC 2 reports, DPAs, and questionnaires, which covers inventory and security-posture review in the platform. Per-vendor data-access tracking and a configurable vendor review cadence are not explicitly documented, and all evidence is marketing copy. missing for 10: explicit vendor data-access classification, documented recurring vendor review cadence/reminders tied to vendors, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet

citations.quote: Vanta's TPRM Agent automatically discovers vendors, accelerates assessments, and monitors third-party risk.
Vanta automatically pulls findings from your vendors SOC2 reports, DPAs, and questionnaires so your team focuses on high-stakes decisions, not paperwork.
